NEW_1.caption: Template ID
NEW_1.doc: Starts with 'tpl_'. Find it in your DocSpring account, or with Find Templates.
NEW_1.name: templateId

NEW_2.caption: Template Version
NEW_2.doc: Optional. A published version such as 1.2.0 (or 1 for the latest 1.x.x), latest, or draft. Default: the latest published version (the draft when none has been published).
NEW_2.name: version

NEW_3.caption: Data
NEW_3.doc: The values of the template's fields, by field name. Use '/' for nested fields and lists, such as 'address/city' or 'items/0/name'. Date fields take dates as YYYY-MM-DD. For an image field, use 'image_name/url' with an image URL.
NEW_3.name: data

NEW_4.caption: Enable Booleans
NEW_4.doc: If enabled, any fields with the exact value of "true" or "false" will be parsed as booleans (true and false) instead of as text.
NEW_4.name: parseAsBoolean

NEW_5.caption: Test Mode
NEW_5.doc: Test PDFs are free, but they include watermarks. A test API token always makes test PDFs.
NEW_5.name: test

NEW_6.caption: Signature Requests (JSON)
NEW_6.doc: Optional. A JSON list of signature requests to check with the data, as in Create Signature Request's More Signers (JSON).
NEW_6.name: signatureRequests
